links.surface: أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ الْآبِيُّ الْعَرُوضِيُّ
أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ
أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ سِنَانٍ الْمَوْصِلِيُّ

notes: «قال حدثني أبي» names the father by relation only; he is the transmitter of the whole account, while the Imam and the delegates speak inside it.
«رضي الله عنه», «ع» and «عليه السلام» removed; the compiler's comment «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is not a link.

notes: «بمرو» (place) and «رضي الله عنه» are left out of the surfaces
«حدثني أبي» is a bare relation: the father of Ali b. Sinan, who gives the first-person account (rule 6)

The Qa'im, Hasan al-Askari and Ja'far speak and act inside the father's account; it is a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks and acts, so whether it is sourced or only scene needs a ruling (rule 11)
The closing «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is the compiler's own comment, not a link
